name: Universitat de Barcelona
summary: Public university across Barcelona's city campuses; two bachelor's taught in English, International Business and English Studies.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10), then Catalonia's pre-enrolment. Only PAU specific-phase or UNED PCE exams lift it towards 14; IB subject grades on the credential do not count.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in International Business
programmes.about: Managing and directing companies and institutions with a global outlook, taught in English at the Faculty of Economics and Business, with further business languages.
programmes.ib: English 73.6% of teaching; the other 26.4% is in other (foreign business) languages.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; 80 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in English Studies
programmes.about: An advanced command of English with applied linguistics and literature, analysing cultural, linguistic and literary paradigms; taught 100% in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the July 2026 admission grade was 5.000, the lowest possible access grade. 160 places.

notes: Business Administration and Management and Biomedical Engineering teach part of their courses in English, but most of the degree is in Catalan and Spanish.
Bioinformatics is taught in English jointly by UB, UPC, UAB and UPF, and is listed under the Polytechnic University of Catalonia, which coordinates it.
